description: Geluidscontouren vliegveld Twente (vlakken) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Beperkingengebieden in verband met geluid. Het luchtverkeer naar en van de luchthaven brengt geluidbelasting met zich mee voor de omgeving. Deze geluidbelasting is in het Milieueffectrapport in beeld gebracht volgens de daarvoor geldende methode. Op grond daarvan zijn de beperkingengebieden vastgesteld voor de 70, 56 en 48 dB(A) Lden-geluidscontouren. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are geluid, geluidhinder, geluidszones, vliegvelden. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC, HTTPS://DATA.OVERHEID.NL/FORMAT/UNKNOWN. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
